query: Economist/YouGov weekly poll Trump approval August 2025

results.content:
July 28, 2026

Americans' approval of Donald Trump's job performance continues to decline, according to the July 25 - 27 Economist / YouGov Poll. 34% of U.S. adult citizens strongly or somewhat approve of Trump's job performance, tied for a record low for either Trump term, while a record 62% disapprove. That's a net job approval of -28, also a record low.

At this point in Trump's first term, he had a net job approval of -9.
results.title: Trump's job approval hits record low, driven down by Gen X, white Americans, and Independents

results.content:
A new Economist/YouGov poll, released Aug. 11, found that 33% of Americans approve of Trump's job performance, down 3 percentage points from the previous week. This marks the lowest approval rating the president has received in YouGov tracking since returning to office in 2025. [...] Since late May, Trump's net approval, the difference between approval and disapproval ratings, has dropped to 2% after lingering around 4% since early July. Most recently, 47% of Tennessee residents approve of his performance, 45% disapprove, and 8% are neutral.
